europe_now.title: Ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus with over 260 on board
europe_now.summary: A ferry carrying more than 260 people has capsized off the coast of northern Cyprus, with reports of multiple fatalities and dozens still missing. Rescue operations are ongoing in the region as authorities work to locate survivors and recover those missing.

sources.headline: Eight killed and others missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
Ferry carrying more than 260 people capsizes off northern Cyprus

europe_now.title: Russia preparing massive strikes on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure
europe_now.summary: Intelligence sources indicate Russia is planning large-scale attacks targeting Ukraine’s energy facilities, raising concerns about widespread disruption. The potential strikes come amid ongoing tensions in the region and follow recent escalations in cross-border hostilities.

sources.headline: Russia preparing ‘massive strikes against Ukraine’s energy facilities’

top_stories.title: Iceland votes against restarting EU accession talks
top_stories.summary: Icelandic voters have rejected a proposal to resume negotiations on joining the European Union, marking a decisive shift in the country’s foreign policy stance. The outcome reflects broader public sentiment favoring independence over deeper integration with European institutions.

sources.headline: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
🔴 Iceland rejects restarting EU accession talks in referendum

top_stories.title: Greece and Turkey escalate tensions over Aegean marine protections
top_stories.summary: Disputes between Greece and Turkey over protected marine areas in the Aegean Sea have intensified, with both sides accusing each other of provocative actions. The tensions highlight longstanding geopolitical friction in the region and raise concerns about potential military escalation.

sources.headline: Greece, Turkey clash over protected Aegean marine areas

top_stories.title: Swiss rave shooting leaves casualties as manhunt continues
top_stories.summary: A shooting at a rave party in Switzerland has left at least one person dead and several others injured, prompting a large-scale manhunt for the suspect. Authorities have not yet released details on the motive or identity of those involved.

sources.headline: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five

top_stories.title: French far-right and far-left dominate latest opinion polls
top_stories.summary: Recent polling in France shows the far-right and far-left leading over centrist and traditional parties ahead of upcoming elections. The trend underscores growing political polarization and voter dissatisfaction with mainstream political options.
